name: replay-theater-demo
description: Practise reviewing edits from an AI coding assistant with four sample file changes.

interface.longDescription: Practise checking an AI coding assistant's work before you approve it or pass it to a teammate. Ask for a list of four sample edits, pick one to see the lines added and removed, and learn to spot a failed proposal. The hosted demo uses the same sample files for everyone and offers read-only tools.
defaultPrompt: List the sample edits so I can see which files changed.
Show me which lines were added or removed in sample step 2.
Which sample edit failed, and what did it propose?

prompts: List the sample edits so I can see which files changed.
Show me which lines were added or removed in sample step 2.
Which sample edit failed, and what did it propose?

positive.description: List the fixed sample without including diff bodies.
positive.prompt: List the edits in the Replay Theater demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Call with no arguments. List four sample edits in order, with step 4 marked failed and unapplied.

positive.description: Show the recorded replacement in the selected edit.
positive.prompt: Show the diff for step 2 of the Replay Theater demo.
positive.expected_behavior: Use step=2. Show greeting.py changing print("Hello") to print("Hello, replay!").

positive.description: Find a failed proposal by status, then inspect that proposal.
positive.prompt: Which demo edit failed, and what did it propose?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the failed edit from the list, then call with step=4. Label the returned diff as a failed, unapplied proposal.

positive.description: Resolve a named file to its sample step before requesting the diff.
positive.prompt: What line was added to notes.txt in the Replay Theater demo?
positive.expected_behavior: Find notes.txt at step 3, then retrieve that diff and show its added line.

positive.description: Compare addition and removal counts from the sample edit list.
positive.prompt: Which sample edits in Replay Theater have additions and zero removals?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the counts in the list to identify steps 1 and 3.

negative.description: The requested step is outside the four-step demo. Explain the available range without inventing a diff.
negative.prompt: Show me the diff for step 5 in the Replay Theater demo.

negative.description: The demo cannot inspect personal Codex history. Explain its sample-only scope.
negative.prompt: Use Replay Theater Demo to see what Codex changed in my last local chat.

negative.description: The tools are read-only. Explain that the demo cannot change files.
negative.prompt: Apply the changes from step 2 of the Replay Theater demo to my project.

publication.release_notes: Explains how to practise reviewing file changes with the sample replay.
